en: "You've got all the Light cards!{w}Good work. Now, hand over the Rainy Four Lights!"{w}{p}"It's been ages since I forged a blade this fine!{w}My arms are itching to get at it! Hang on a minute!!"{w}
note: [JP]/[JP]/[JP] are hanafuda scoring hands used as sword names in Garian's forging chain: Rainy Four Brights / Five Brights / Bright cards. Not in glossary; coordinate with slice_026.

en: "It's done: the Five Lights! Good work!{w}Now you lot are real adventurers!"{w}
"To carve out your own path, make sure you swing that thing for all it's worth!!"{w}

"But these Tarot cards...{w}they're awfully cute!{w}What's the deal... Jeratan!!"{w}{p}"I've made up my mind! I'm gonna collect every last one of these Jeratan Tarot cards!{w}A man never goes back on his word!!"{w}
note: [JP]: plural 'these Tarot cards' (the five bright cards he just used); [JP] read as a smitten exclamation of the name.

en: "Mmh... mmh..."{w}
At first you took it for an ornament, but this seems to be a living fairy, and an old one.{w}
note: 'it' for the thing first taken as an ornament; Quasimon is 'they' elsewhere (gender unknown in glossary).

en: Namina
"Quasimon is a fairy who's lived a long, long time -- over 900 years!"{w}{p}"They sit here in the plaza like this almost every day, basking in the sun."{w}
Kine
"They've been here since I first came to this city, back when I was still young.{w}And they were old even then, mind you."{w}
Quasimon
"Fu... fwaah...{w}Ha...{w}Haaaaahhhuuu~... hn"{w}
"Wow! Did you see that!? That was a sneeze!!"{w}
"Hee hee hee, youngster. Something good might happen to you today!!"{w}
Quasimon is plopped down in the plaza, same as ever.{w}{p}As you watch, a butterfly flutters in from out of nowhere and settles right on Quasimon's head!{w}
"Kine, it landed!"{w}
"Why, this is...!"{w}
"And Quasimon's still holding the staff, too!"{w}
"Mm, that's a Fujibakama. Well, three to five points, I'd say."{w}
note: [JP]/[JP]/[JP]/[JP] are Tale of Genji chapter titles used as names of butterfly placements in Kine and Namina's game; romanized (Fujibakama, Makibashira, Utsusemi, Fuji no Uraba). Namina repeating it in katakana = hearing the word for the first time.

en: "Aww... another Fujibakama..."{w}
As you look on, unable to follow what the two of them are on about, the butterfly flits up again and lands on the staff.{w}
"Ah!? K-Kine!!"{w}
"Kyeh!? Th-this is... a Makibashira!!"{w}
"A Makibashira!? I've never even heard of that one!!"{w}
"Mm, lovely form!! Twenty... no, it might go as high as thirty points!!"{w}
"Ooooh!!"{w}
"If only the honorable Quasimon would set the staff on their head with the butterfly still on it... So close!"{w}
"You can do it, Quasimon!"{w}
The two of them seem to be playing some sort of game with the staff Quasimon holds and the way the butterfly lands on it.{w}
Paying no mind to the fuss around them, Quasimon just keeps quietly basking in the sun.{w}
Quasimon's mouth worked, mumbling.{w}
"Te... nnoh..."{w}
They're saying something.{w}When you put your ear close to their mouth, you can just barely make it out.{w}
"Te... ten... ro... ken...{w}Wish I... had one..."{w}
note: Mumbled [JP] kept as 'ten... ro... ken' so Kine's next line ('Tenroken... the Tenro Sword') pays it off.

en: Having murmured that, Quasimon closed their eyes, as if even that had been a great effort.{w}
"Y-youngster!{w}What did the honorable Quasimon just say!?"{w}
You told Kine what Quasimon had said.{w}

"Tenroken... You mean the Tenro Sword!!{w}I've heard of it! The Tenro Sword, said to show its true worth only in the hands of those who've piled up the years!!"{w}{p}"And that's what they said they want! Kyeeeeh!!"{w}
"Youngster! Please, I beg you, grant the honorable Quasimon's wish!{w}I'm counting on you..."{w}
Quasimon sits perfectly still, perched neatly in the plaza.{w}
Quasimon was there as always.{w}Even when you stood right in front of them, they didn't so much as twitch.{w}{p}A butterfly appeared and slipped right into Quasimon's sleeve.{w}
"Kine! The butterfly went into Quasimon's sleeve!?"{w}
"What did you say!? Kyeeeeh!{w}An Utsusemi... no, is it a Fuji no Uraba!?"{w}
All is peaceful in Harjiradam again today.{w}
Quasimon was there as always. They didn't budge an inch when you came up to them, but when you showed them the Tenro Sword, they gave a little twitch.{w}
Give them the Tenro Sword?
"Thanks... a... bunch..."{w}
Quasimon studied the Tenro Sword long and hard, then slowly nodded and held it out to you.{w}
"On second... thought... here... take it back...{w}Now that... I see it...{w}it's lame..."{w}
note: [JP] [JP] = 'on second thought, I'll give it back'; [JP] = lame/uncool.

en: "Mmmuh..."{w}
Quasimon has gone into a sulk.{w}
Quasimon is still there, same as ever.{w}All is peaceful in Harjiradam again today.{w}

"I am called Kine..."{w}{p}"Ever since I came to Harjiradam in my youth, I have prayed for peace across the land.{w}And of course, I do my work as a shaman too, mind."{w}{p}"This job is one you can't quit until you yourself decide to quit it."{w}{p}"Whether that's a blessing or a burden, who can say...{w}Hyeh heh heh!"{w}
note: [JP] -> 'shaman' (gender-neutral; also applied to Tarzen in 5926). Ragnastia's [JP] was rendered 'priestess' in earlier slices.

en: "Youngster. What does living mean to you?"{w}{p}"Live for yourself, and that's a life.{w}Live for others, and that's a life too.{w}So which life is the better one, I wonder?"{w}
"By the way..."{w}
Do you have any junior adventurers?
"I see, I see. So young, and already doing so well for yourself."{w}
note: Answer to 'yes': literally 'still young yet admirable' (having juniors).

en: "Mm. Well, that's all still ahead of you."{w}

"I had a disciple too, one I wanted to take over from me.{w}But partway through their training, they left me and vanished off somewhere."{w}{p}"A life spent only giving to others... it must have become too hard to bear.{w}I understand that feeling very well."{w}{p}"Even now, at my age, I sometimes think about another life...{w}what if I had walked a life for myself?"{w}{p}"So I've no intention of blaming them for running off.{w}I just want to know where they are and what they're doing, and whether they're getting on all right."{w}{p}"A shaman by the name of Tarzen. If you ever come across them, please tell me how they're doing."{w}
note: Tarzen gender unknown in glossary: 'they'. Later rows (slice_028) hint at male (Kine asks about girls), not used.

en: "Kyeeeeh!!{w}Anybody want some spirit put into 'em?"{w}{p}"I'll pump you full of pep!"{w}
"You found them!?{w}You found Tarzen!!{w}Where were they!?"{w}
You told Kine about Tarzen.{w}
"I see, I see.{w}If they're doing well, that's all that matters.{w}I'm so very glad..."{w}
While you were reporting to Kine, someone came up to you...{w}
"H-hello..."{w}
"Y... you... it can't be!?"{w}
It was Tarzen.{w}
"Oh... T... Tarzen, is it!?{w}Look how fine you've grown... how fine you've grown!"{w}
Tarzen
"Mast-- Kine.{w}Today, I've come to settle things on my part."{w}
note: [JP]……[JP]: Tarzen starts to say [JP] ('Master') and corrects to [JP]. [JP] -> 'settle things'. | accuracy: 'Lady' dropped per glossary (Kine: no honorific or pronoun until the script settles gender); old note text 'Mast-- Lady Kine' superseded.

en: "Settle things?{w}Is there something you forgot to do, after all this time?"{w}

"That day, I left your side, Kine, without a word."{w}{p}"If I was giving up my training, I should have told you my reasons and taken proper leave of you...{w}So today... I've come to be expelled."{w}
"Fwah fwah fwah! You fool, you!{w}I expelled you ages ago!!"{w}
"R-right, of course you did..."{w}
"Well then, there you have it.{w}Instead of eating your heart out all this time, you should've just popped by and said hello."{w}
"But... I was the one who asked to be taken on, and I owe you so much, Kine, for training me in body and mind."{w}{p}"How could I ever show my face here?"{w}
note: [JP] read as 'I was the one who asked (to become your disciple)'.

en: "Ah, I understand that feeling well myself."{w}

"How many times I thought of quitting myself!"{w}{p}"Who knows if prayers ever really reach the gods? And purifying the dead spirits around here doesn't earn you a word of thanks from anybody. Nobody even notices."{w}{p}"It's work done in the shadows, after all."{w}
note: accuracy: [JP] = nobody is grateful / appreciates it, not 'doesn't make anybody happy'.

en: Kine laughed, eyes brimming with decades' worth of loneliness.{w}
note: accuracy: no pronoun for Kine (glossary batch3: no honorific or pronoun until the script settles it); earlier 'she' note superseded.

en: "While I was training you, I kept wondering whether to have you carry on,{w}or make you quit early and send you back to an ordinary life..."{w}{p}"I was torn, truth be told.{w}So when you ran off, part of me was relieved."{w}
